name: Salvia divinorum
tierNotes: Threshold: faint lateral lean — the whole frame wants to go left (early sway).
Light: shear bands barely visible at frame edges; 3 bands.
Common: visible diagonal shear strips + constant sideways pull; band count growing.
Strong: ~7 s page-turn events roll the bands over and re-tile with a duplicated strip; cartoon posterize + ink lines (late).

Heavy: reality break — the photo dissolves entirely into a tiled cartoon world of hard rectangular panels conveyor-belting sideways, a flat dark 'being' standing in each, motion stepped to 12 fps (realityBreak crossfade gated above Strong, full at Heavy). More scene-obliterating than DMT's tunnel, in salvia's own idiom.
